blaster.notes: CityWalker hold LMB → BlasterBoltVfx stream; blaster_speed_mps=30, blaster_interval_sec=0.25, energy_cost_blaster=1; DamageSource.PLAYER_BLASTER=18. Aim reach follows laser aim (100m). Player: continuous fire while held (burst_count=1 per tick, fire_interval_s=0.25, cooldown_s=0). Monsters: 3-bolt burst then recover (monster_*).

charged_blast.notes: CityWalker Alt+LMB charge → ChargedBlastVfx; charged_blast_speed_mps=10, charge_sec=1.6, radius_max 2.52×scale, cooldown_sec=0.55, energy_cost_blast=20; DamageSource.PLAYER_BLAST=150. Aim uses same cursor ray as laser (100m). radius_m is max-charge sphere at 1×. Monsters keep full charge windup + long recovery (monster_cooldown_s); shorter AI throw reach (monster_range_m).

debris.notes: Live giant facade scrape (UndeadUnit SCRAPE_INTERVAL_SEC=0.32, GIANT_SCRAPE_DIST_M=3.6). DamageSource.GIANT_DEBRIS=10. Monster-only.

eye_laser.notes: CityWalker Ctrl+LMB → EyeLaserVfx; laser_speed_mps=60, laser_cooldown_sec=0.45, laser_range_m=100, energy_cost_laser=1; DamageSource.PLAYER_LASER=18. Player energy-gated. Monsters: telegraph + longer recovery + shorter engagement (monster_*). PLAYER_LASER still targets CREATURE — wire MONSTER_* when AI fires at the player.

fist.notes: Player punch/kick (CityWalker melee_reach_m=1.05). DamageSource.PLAYER_MELEE=34. No energy; no cooldown export — animation length gates the next strike. Distinct from monster contact `melee` (damage truly diverges).

melee.notes: Basic monster contact/swing. Not yet a DamageSource.Id. Clip binding later: prefer Rogue 1H_Melee_Attack_* then CreatureClips MELEE fallback. Not the player fist (see `fist`).

nibble.notes: Live minion building chew (UndeadUnit MINION_NIBBLE_INTERVAL_SEC=15, MINION_NIBBLE_REACH_M=2.4). Damage is voxel removal, not a creature HP hit — damage_vs_* stay 0.

orb_convert.notes: Live mage convert orb (UndeadUnit CAST_COOLDOWN_SEC=20, ORB_RANGE_M=30; UndeadOrbProjectile SPEED_MPS=25, CAPTURE_RADIUS_M=1.76). DamageSource.UNDEAD_ORB=25 — four hits empty the player's 100 HP pool. Monster-only; energy_cost=0.

stomp.notes: CityWalker Q → feet-centered crater; radius = charged_blast_radius_max_m×scale (2.52 at 1×), stomp_cooldown_sec=0.85, energy_cost_stomp=10, stomp_impact_ratio=0.48; DamageSource.PLAYER_STOMP=110. Player windup is anim-ratio (not seconds). Monsters: ~0.4s foot telegraph + 6s recovery.
